name: Shokushu Makai no Ryoshuu ~Jain no Nie ni Sasagerareta Futari no Otome Marika & Emily~
original_name: 触手魔界の虜囚～邪淫の贄に捧げられた2人の乙女マリカ&エミリ～
source:
The kingdom of Lanrod was bearer of a protective seal that restrained an ancient god.
In order to save the already-captured warrior princess Ixia and the other two original protectors anointed by the goddess Elixia herself, Marika and Emily faced heretic believer Zodiac.
But Zodiac got the better of them, and the two heroines were also captured.
Then he unleashed his violating tentacles on the duo...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118894.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
兰罗德王国拥有束缚古神的保护封印。
为了拯救已经被俘虏的战士公主伊克希亚以及女神艾利希亚亲自指定的另外两名原始保护者，玛丽卡和艾米丽面对异端信徒十二宫。
但十二宫战胜了他们，两位女主角也被俘虏了。
然后他向两人释放了侵犯的触手……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE118894.html]DLsite English[/url]]
